bundle.name: stark-plan
bundle.description: Turn a design doc into a phased implementation plan, then decompose it into phased GitHub issues with story points and risk labels. Maps to spec-kit's plan + tasks phases.

artifacts.name: stark-author
artifacts.description: Stage 1 — spec+plan authoring in one session, the operator decides: tier check, time-boxed recon, plain-language interview (only what only they know), one self-contained doc, one zero-context advisory pass, plain-language sign-off, commit-pinned handoff. No LLM review loops. Use for author, spec, plan a change.
